I told Hollis in a thread reply in #central-team that the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal is for 382 seats.

Before answering, I checked that Hollis is a member of #central-team, so the answer only uses what he can see himself. Tobias posted the 382 figure in that channel on Oct 14, and nothing posted since then changes it. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the account's team.

One thing to flag: my wrap-up note from Tobias's request ended up in #central-team as a separate message, not just in his thread. It only says the seat count was noted, which the channel could already see, so nothing sensitive went out.
